Remove the legacy web version; document the Godot game's current state (#5)

game/ (PixiJS) and app/ (Expo shell) were only kept as the reference
for the Godot port, which is now on TestFlight as 0.3.0 (6). The one
piece still needed, the EAS project link that eas submit runs from,
moves to a minimal eas/ folder (app.json, eas.json); the downloaded
signing credentials live there too, gitignored. CI now imports the
Godot project and runs the core tests instead of building the web app.

CLAUDE.md gains a "Current state" section (what works, placeholder
art, what's unverified on device, known port gaps) and drops the dead
Expo build path; HD2D.md, README and the normalizer point at the
Godot files.

Port Wildbound to Godot 4.7 for a real HD-2D diorama (#4)

The PixiJS build could only fake HD-2D with pre-blurred flat layers.
Godot gives a real 3D stage (pixel sprites standing in lit geometry,
depth of field, glow, shadows) while keeping every rule, number and
screen of the web version, which stays in game/ and app/ as the
reference until the Godot build is confirmed on device.

- godot/: core (Data, S, Meta, Battle; 328 logic tests), UI (HUD,
  card fan with tap-to-inspect and flick-to-play, all screens, run
  flow), stage (3D biomes, actors with per-element recolour,
  particles, hit-stop/slow-mo/shake). CONTRACT.md maps TS modules to
  autoloads and fixes the cross-module APIs.
- iOS: export preset (0.3.0, build counter in godot/ios), Mac build
  script that signs with a throwaway keychain from the EAS credentials
  (gitignored) and runs xcodebuild itself; submit stays eas submit.
- CLAUDE.md Part 2, README and ship.json describe the Godot workflow.

HD-2D art style, loot economy instead of capture, fanned card hand (#3)

Capture is gone: creatures now come only from packs (daily, or bought
with gold), so dungeons needed a new reason to play. Wins drop gold and
Sword/Orb/Jewel materials, banked immediately and kept win or lose; they
buy permanent per-creature upgrades (Power/Spirit/Vitality) or trade in
the new item shop. The run starts with a picked team of up to 3. This
reverses pillar 4 on purpose; CLAUDE.md Part 1 is rewritten to match.

The hand is now a fan held like real cards: tap to inspect, flick up to
play, so a stray tap no longer spends a card.

New default art style 'hd2d': the three normalized anchor sprites
(Sable, ember fox, dragon) stand in for all creatures, hue-shifted per
element (canvas bake at preload, outlines and skin kept), and a
procedural diorama background (pre-blurred depth layers, light shafts,
tilt-shift strips, motes), no extra image assets.

Also: HD-2D sprite template (docs/HD2D.md) and normalizer
(scripts/hd2d-sprite.py) that snaps ChatGPT output onto its own pixel
grid instead of forcing a height, with anchors per body type.

Loadouts: alternate cards, Traits, Essence (#2)

* Loadout foundation: alternate cards, Trait defs, Essence/loadout API

Card slots become option lists (index 0 = the old card) and each
creature gets a built-in Trait, so the deck stays 'your team' but
each creature can be built. cardOf resolves the equipped card; a named
evolution only replaces the default Signature, alternates get Prime
x1.4. meta.ts gains per-element Essence, unlocks and saved loadouts.
bonusBurned generalizes to bonusIf; multi-hit cards add 'hits'.
Trait effects, the loadout UI, earning and the spec land next.

* Loadouts: Trait effects, Essence earning, loadout editor, spec §16

- battle.ts: all 12 Traits keyed off the socketed Mon.trait (not the
  species' built-in), each with a named popup so the passive is
  readable mid-fight. debug.essence/debug.trait for testing.
- run.ts: Essence per won fight (catch pays instead of the Wild
  amount, flee pays nothing), duplicate catches convert at run end,
  end screen shows the run's gains. Collection becomes the loadout
  editor: unlock/equip alternates, learn/socket Traits. Unlocking
  auto-equips to save a tap. Loadouts never change mid-run (pillar 3).
- Party screen and lead plate show the Trait.
- actor.ts: kill a running hit-flash tween on destroy (it could
  touch a destroyed filter if a battle ended mid-flash).
- CLAUDE.md: new §16, roster tables gain alternates and Traits,
  evolution rule for alternate Signatures, persisted keys.

Merge pull request #1 from taigamura/mvp-design

Implement MVP game design; CLAUDE.md as single source of truth

Implement MVP game design; make CLAUDE.md the single source of truth

CLAUDE.md now holds the full design spec (Part 1) alongside the
engineering guide (Part 2). README and docs/ART.md defer to it.

Combat
- Deck is the 3-creature lineup's cards (Strike/Skill/Signature);
  playing a bench creature's card swaps it in
- Tap-to-swap for 1 energy, 1s cooldown shared with card swaps
- Intent bar; every 3rd attack is a named heavy (+2s wind-up, 2.5x,
  applies its element's status)
- Perfect Swap: resist the heavy in its last 0.4s for 0 damage,
  50% reflect, +2 energy and slow-mo
- Chain meter (+10% per step, max +50%)
- Statuses: Burn, Soak, Root, Shock; shields decay after 3s
- Leveling removed: creatures start every run at roster stats

Capture and run
- Capture charges, odds formula, enrage on failure, flee timer
- Party of 6 with a lineup of 3 and a lineup screen
- Two biomes with separate spawn pools and backgrounds; Alpha, Spring,
  Warden (Gravewood) on floor 4, Noctyrm on floor 8
- Rewards: upgrade a card (+30% effect or -1 cost), heal, or +1 charge

Evolution and meta
- Run starter evolves mid-fight; named evolutions for the 3 starters,
  "Prime" for others; scaled-base + glow fallback when a style lacks art
- Daily pack (04:00 reset), shinies, collection screen,
  keep-all-on-win / keep-one-on-loss, one-tap "Run again"

Art layer
- ArtStyle.scene(biome) and optional has(species); sprite packs get sceneB
- Dusk pack images renamed to the new species keys

Wildbound 2D: PixiJS game with swappable art styles + Expo iOS shell

- game/: 2D port on PixiJS 8 + GSAP, TypeScript modules (core/render/art/game)
- art/: ArtStyle contract (creature, scene, pedestal, ambience, css vars),
  registry with persistence and ?art= override, title-screen picker
- Sticker style (procedural vector) and Dusk image pack (PNGs + manifest,
  falls back per creature), auto-discovered from art/packs/<id>/
- tools/exportPack: bake procedural creatures into a sprite pack with anchors
- app/: Expo SDK 57 WebView shell, AsyncStorage saves, haptics, EAS config
- docs/ART.md: how to drop in AI-generated art
